data.name: Hauntasy
data.detailed_description:
Do you believe in ghosts?

A wealthy baron offers you one million dollars to spend seven nights inside his family's supposedly haunted manor. As night falls, you'll monitor the estate through an old television, watching for signs of paranormal activity as an unseen presence moves from room to room. Relight failing candles to hold back the darkness, install flame sensors to aid your investigation, and balance your matches, money, hunger, and sanity as you struggle to survive until dawn.

If the manor truly is haunted... you're not alone.

If it isn't...

Prove it.

Features

  • Survive seven increasingly dangerous nights.

  • Survive alone or with a friend in 2-player couch co-op.

  • Every playthrough is different with randomized room and TV channel layouts.

  • Track paranormal activity through an old television set.

  • Relight candles to hold back the darkness.

  • Install flame sensors to reveal ghostly movement.

  • Manage matches, money, hunger, and sanity.

  • Catch over 100 species of fish to stay fed.

  • Face multiple paranormal entities, each with unique behaviors.

  • Purchase and expand the estate to uncover new haunted locations.

  • A tense blend of psychological horror, strategy, and resource management.

Game Modes

Story Mode
Survive all seven nights and claim the baron's reward.

Co-op Baron Mode

Face the estate together in a cooperative survival mode.

------------------------------------------------------------

A Note from the Developer

My mission is simple:

I want to scare you.

If I succeeded... please let me know.

data.short_description: Do you believe in ghosts? A wealthy baron offers you $1,000,000 to take part in the Hauntasy, a seven-night challenge inside his family's supposedly haunted estate. Keep watch, manage your limited resources, and survive until dawn to claim the reward.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or equivalent with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad supported. 1920×1080 display recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen) / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror, frightening imagery, jump scares, and themes involving ghosts, supernatural entities, death, and paranormal activity. Players may encounter unsettling environments, disturbing character designs, and moments of tension intended to create fear. The game does not contain graphic gore, explicit violence, sexual content, or nudity.
